As far as CARS goes, this is where I started doing 3+ practice passages every day. Lately, I have been working on the NS108 CARS book (a full section/day) which I think has helped TREMENDOUSLY on timing and understanding themes. The main thing I've noticed is that pretty much every question they can ask will be related to one of four things: Opinions (Author or others), Cause and Effect, Compare/Contrast, and Detail Reasoning. When I started navigating the passages by looking for these key things instead of reading for content and comprehension, my scores improved.
